title: Align function call telemetry and delta-fragment repair for OpenAI-compat streaming
author: Ava Chen
release_notes: Enrich streaming function/tool call telemetry and add delta-fragment repair to increase stream coherence for OpenAI-compatible tool invocations. No breaking API changes. Improves stability for fragmented tool_call envelopes and enhances observability for triage.
description: Motivation: customer incidents and internal canaries surfaced two related problems for OpenAI-compat streaming tool/function calls: (1) fragmented network/frame boundaries could split tool_call envelopes which led to spurious parse errors or dropped tool invocations; (2) telemetry did not capture the decision path when multiple tool candidates were considered (tool_choice semantics), making post-incident analysis difficult. This PR addresses both by 1) adding a delta-fragment repair pass that coalesces and replays small, out-of-order fragments when safe, and 2) extending the invoke envelope canonicalizer to surface a compact telemetry blob (choice_reason, score, fragment_origin, fragment_sequence, alias_resolution) for every tool selection decision. Changes are designed to be backward compatible with existing OpenAI-compat clients: the repair pass only activates when streaming framing metadata indicates partial envelopes and the telemetry fields are opt-in via feature flag. Included are tests that reproduce the class of fragment-split failures, integration tests with the streaming harness, and updated docs for operators. Checklist: [x] delta-fragment algorithm implemented and unit-tested [x] telemetry fields schema and ingestion path added [x] feature-flag gating and rollout notes added [x] integration tests against streaming harness [x] docs/console examples updated. Impact: reduces tool_call parse errors observed in canaries by ~78% and surfaces richer post-hoc signals for debugging model->tool routing decisions.

review_thread: Miguel Torres: Left a couple of nit comments on the heuristics (prefer explicit threshold constants over magic numbers). Can you add a short note on how thresholds were chosen?
Ava Chen: Responded with benchmarks: thresholds chosen from canary trace sampling; added comments and a short section in docs about tuning.
Riley Patel: Verified that the repair pass is behind the feature flag and approved the approach but requested that we add a metric for 'fragments_repaired' so SRE can monitor rollout.
Ava Chen: Added fragments_repaired counter and a Grafana panel; posted screenshot in PR thread.

Samir Gupta: Ran streaming e2e and observed a flakiness that turned out to be a missing backpressure check; requested an additional guard which was added in fix commit e55f6a1. Approved after the fix.
merge_commit: squash-merge: align function call telemetry and fragment repair — c1a9f7b
notes_for_release: Admins can enable 'openai_streaming_fragment_repair' via the feature-flagging console; default off for all customers. Recommended rollout: enable in staging, monitor fragments_repaired and tool_invoke_failures for 24h, then enable in canary region. Backfill: telemetry consumers should be updated to accept the optional 'tool_choice' blob (schema v2).
operator_migration_steps: 1) Update telemetry pipeline to accept tool_choice_schema_v2.json; 2) Toggle feature flag in staging; 3) Validate reduced parse error rate and fragments_repaired metric; 4) Gradually promote to canary and production.
customer_impact: Low risk: no client-visible API change. Enables more robust handling of fragmented streaming messages and better telemetry for debugging. Some internal dashboards require a small schema update to surface new fields.
testing_summary: Unit tests cover fragment coalescing edge cases, fuzzed partial-frame inputs, and alias resolution. Integration tests exercise an end-to-end streaming scenario with synthetic partial frames. Added a short-lived canary run showing 78% reduction in parse failures over 48h.
